Name: Custom Tracker
Author: EscaMMC
TagLine: Replaces the player's forage tracker icon with a large yellow arrow. The icon can be customized and should support any size or shape.
Description:
Custom Tracker replaces the player's forage tracker icon with a large yellow arrow. The icon can be customized and should support any size or shape.

It also includes options to track additional forage and object types, display the specific objects being tracked, and more.

- - - - -
Installation
- - - - -
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Install the latest version of Content Patcher.
3. Download CustomTracker from the Download tab above, the GitHub Releases page, or Nexus Mods.
4. Unzip CustomTracker into your Stardew Valley\Mods folder.

- - - - -
Customization
- - - - -
By default, Custom Tracker will hide the original tracker icon and replace it with a large yellow arrow.

The mod can also be customized to track additional forage types (including spring onions and salmonberry/blackberry bushes), display the specific forage being tracked by each icon, and more.

To replace the tracker icon or customize this mod's available settings, please see the [readme file on GitHub](https://github.com/Esca-MMC/CustomTracker).

- - - - -
Compatibility
- - - - -
Custom Tracker should not conflict with any known mods. However, mods that edit the original tracker's appearance may cause it to reappear.

This mod can be used in multiplayer. The custom tracker will only be visible to players who have the mod, and it will use their personal settings.

It also supports spacechase0's Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM). Go to Stardew's main menu, click the gear icon, and select Custom Tracker to change this mod's settings.
